template:
Rewrite the following text with {level_description}. Preserve the meaning and all words exactly — only introduce typos through character-level errors (swapped letters, missing letters, doubled letters, adjacent key presses). Do not change words, add words, or alter sentence structure. Return only the rewritten text, nothing else.

{prompt}

metadata.notes: Used by to_rewrite_with_typos_* functions in typos.py. level_description controls typo density. One call per prompt.
